founded.name: Women in Cloud Native
founded.imageAlt: A large group of women at the Women in Cloud Native meetup at KubeCon London
founded.story: It started with a single tweet. Today Women in Cloud Native is a global community that runs hands-on workshops and hosts a meetup at every KubeCon around the world. At KubeCon London, over 90% of the women in this photo were first-time attendees.
